svg.aria-label: TIDA-010083 system block diagram grouped by function
svg.text: Isolated IEEE 802.3at Type 1 PoE powered device plus a 10/100/1000 Ethernet PHY in 27 × 27 mm. Three signal bands; isolation is crossed three separate times.
integrated MDI termination · >8 kV IEC ESD
TX < 90 ns, RX < 290 ns RGMII latency
1588 SFD · WoL · TDR · 495 mW at 1 Gb/s
Band 2 · PoE powered device and isolated power conversion
20 mV drop · 100 V FET · injected at V_PD, ahead of the flyback
Each channel is isolated from the other and from logic ground.
The field side is loop-powered and needs no supply of its own.
Inputs pass a 150 ns pulse; the output optocoupler is far slower.

g.text: Isolation is functional, not reinforced. It is crossed by the Ethernet transformer, the flyback transformer, and the ISO1212 and optocoupler — three independent barriers, not one continuous line across the board.
